missions.title: C3, Year 95
missions.desc: Five years ago. A Government facility in the city of Aurora. Your first day in C3.

lines.t: Year 95. Five years ago, at a Government facility in the city of Aurora.
Sintrie! Get up! The new hire's here and you're asleep again.
lines.group: Sintrie! Get up! The new hires are here and you're asleep again.
lines.duo: Sintrie! Get up! {names} are here - two new hires - and you're asleep again.
lines.trio: Sintrie! Get up! Three new hires - {names} - and you're asleep again.
lines.full: Sintrie! FOUR new hires - {names} - and you're asleep again!

lines.t: Uh? ...Morning, Tech. Welcome to C3. Don't let her steal your stuff.
lines.sky: Uh? ...Another Skylander? Huh. Nice not being the only one in this place for once.

lines.t: I'm Technica - Tech. I turn people into demons for a living... and I hate it. We help who we can.
...Got it.
Oh no, my camouflage body wore off. Hello, new C3.
lines.sky: Oh no, my camouflage body wore off. ...Well, well. A Skylander in C3. Fascinating. We should talk - in my lab.

lines.t: Kyle. No military equipment inside the facility.
I'm C2 now - human modifications. Run along, you two lovebirds.
lines.sky: I'm C2 now. Human modifications. But Skylanders... Skylanders are my favorite. Come by any time.

lines.t: Who's the new girl in green?
Yuri Tenjo. Fourteen. Highest score ever - straight to C1. Her family ran from the demon draft.
Rumor is her big brother's being tested on for Project Ultima. Weak people are better used as weapons.
NO! Everyone has a purpose, Kyle!

reply.t: See? Even the new one gets it.
reply.group: See? Even the new ones get it.

missions.title: Escape Keys
missions.desc: Technica secretly gives the gas patients a way out. Help her hand out the keys.

lines.t: Fifty patients for the demon gas. I made each one a key to the escape rooms. Help me get them out before the guards notice.
I'll watch the cameras. Go.

steps.obj: Keep the guards off Technica while the patients escape
Guards at both exits - Technica holds one while you clear the other

lines.t: Five stayed. Ava, Barry, Kaitlyn, Persephone, Zack. Why would anyone stay?
Maybe they've got nothing left out there. You can't help everyone, Tech.
...You helped forty-five.
(smiles) ...Yeah. I did. Thanks.
lines.group: (smiles) ...Yeah. We did. Thanks, all of you.
lines.trio: (smiles) ...Yeah. We did. Thanks, {names}. All three of you.
lines.full: (smiles) ...Yeah. We did. {names} - thanks. All of you.

missions.title: Kyle's Errand
missions.desc: Kyle needs test data from C2's modified soldiers. He asked for you specifically.

lines.t: My modified soldiers need a real opponent. Don't worry, they're expendable. So are you, mostly.
lines.sky: My modified soldiers need a real opponent - and a Skylander's combat data is priceless. Do try not to die. I'd hate to waste you.

lines.t: Excellent data. Will Break works better on them now. Thank you.
lines.sky: Excellent. EXCELLENT. You're even better than I hoped. We'll do this again.

missions.title: Project Ultima
missions.desc: Security alert x10. Project Ultima has broken out.

lines.t: Intercom: Security alert x10. Project Ultima has broken out.
Tech, we have to go!
Not without my patients! I'm putting a shield on them. Hold him off - just for a minute!

steps.obj: Hold off Project Ultima while Technica shields the patients

lines.t: The facility blew up.
(In pain) Sintrie... protect my patients...
Tech? TECH! ...She's gone.
Not a mark on me. Invisible AND invincible. Sintrie - a deal. I take Tech's patients, you give me your blood. Deal?
...Deal. Just save them...
And you. You saw everything. ...I'll remember you.
lines.sky: And you - another Skylander, still standing. I'll remember you. Oh, I will.

lines.t: Sintrie woke up five years later with no name. He called himself Max.
